title: Hospices whose whole ownership arrived within 36 months of certification
question: Which Bay Area hospices changed hands soon after winning Medicare certification, the pattern the federal notice calls flipping?
finding: 16 of 67 Bay Area hospices certified for Medicare since 2018, with an owner on file, show every present owner arriving after the hospice was certified for Medicare, the first between 6 and 36 months later; Medicare paid them $39.3 million in 2024. Across California the count is 747 of 1,857 certified since 2018 ($805.1 million in 2024). Largest in the Bay Area: A Plus Prime Care Hospice Inc (Pleasanton): certified 2021-12-11, present owners from 2022-10-01 (9 months later), $8.8 million in 2024; Aveem Inc (Concord): certified 2020-11-18, present owners from 2021-08-25 (9 months later), $4.0 million in 2024; Alameda Care Hospice (Walnut Creek): certified 2021-03-10, present owners from 2022-09-15 (18 months later), $4.0 million in 2024; Home Connect Hospice, LLC. (Fremont): certified 2022-02-09, present owners from 2023-09-01 (18 months later), $4.0 million in 2024.
how: For each hospice enrolment certified in 2018 or later the original Medicare participation date was taken from the federal Provider of Services file by certification number. The owner files give, for every present holder of 5% or more (direct or indirect) or of a partnership interest, the date that tie began. A hospice is listed when the earliest of those dates is between 6 and 36 months after certification, so that nobody who owns it now owned it when it was certified (dates within 6 months are treated as enrolment paperwork and left out). The Federal Register notice of 15 May 2026 describes the pattern: brokers enrol an agency intending to sell it quickly, which is why a "36-month rule" was extended to hospices. Payments are from Medicare's provider payment files.
limits: The association date is whatever the hospice told Medicare; a re-filing, a reorganization of the same family's holding companies, an inheritance or a correction all reset it without any sale. A sale soon after certification was permitted for hospices until the rule the notice describes took effect, and buying a small agency and growing it is an ordinary business. The owner files begin in April 2023, so the owner at certification is not shown, only that no present owner dates from then.
